name: ShengShou Crazy 3x3 V2
description: The ShengShou Crazy 3x3 V2 is a pillowed 3x3 with rings on each face that do not turn with their respective faces. This leads to interesting situations that you would not normally see on a 3x3. The V2 has more pieces (9 total) in each ring, adding yet another layer of difficulty. If you've mastered the 3x3, this is a great next step!
